```shell
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

php -l superdav-ai-newsletter.php

php -r '
spl_autoload_register(static function (string $class): void {
    if ("SdAiNewsletter\\Core\\Plugin" === $class) {
        eval("namespace SdAiNewsletter\\Core; final class Plugin {}");
    }
});

if (class_exists("SdAiNewsletter\\Core\\Plugin", false)) {
    exit("The class should not be loaded before the autoload-enabled check.\n");
}

if (!class_exists("SdAiNewsletter\\Core\\Plugin", true)) {
    exit("The registered autoloader did not resolve the class.\n");
}

echo "Autoload-enabled class_exists() passed.\n";
'
```

**Allow autoload in both `class_exists()` checks.**

`class_exists( ..., false )` only checks whether `SdAiNewsletter\Core\Plugin` is already defined and does not run registered autoloaders. The local Composer autoloader is registered after line 41, but the class is not yet loaded, so the failure at line 44 shows a false missing-dependencies notice and exits before `Plugin`, activation, deactivation, and `plugins_loaded` hooks are registered.

<details>
<summary>Proposed fix</summary>

```diff
-if ( ! class_exists( 'SdAiNewsletter\Core\Plugin', false ) && file_exists( SD_AI_NEWSLETTER_DIR . '/vendor/autoload.php' ) ) {
+if ( ! class_exists( 'SdAiNewsletter\Core\Plugin' ) && file_exists( SD_AI_NEWSLETTER_DIR . '/vendor/autoload.php' ) ) {
	require_once SD_AI_NEWSLETTER_DIR . '/vendor/autoload.php';
}

-if ( ! class_exists( 'SdAiNewsletter\Core\Plugin', false ) ) {
+if ( ! class_exists( 'SdAiNewsletter\Core\Plugin' ) ) {
```

</details>
